Our Story

Daniella Lehavi is an iconic Israeli brand celebrated for its timeless bags that blend elegance, functionality, and sustainability. Founded in 1991 by Daniella Lehavi, the brand was born out of her passion for creating pieces that seamlessly integrate into a woman’s life.
